decision: Do not send the immutable full turret through stock to_glb or the repair/remesh helpers. First persist genuine six-channel texture attributes separately; the cheapest geometry-preserving export is CPU sampled vertex RGBA, with metallic/roughness retained as sidecars until a separate UV/PBR bake is qualified.

raw_mesh.nonmanifold: Reported by parent; not rescanned here.
raw_mesh.policy: Preserve original PLY, all source positions/faces/winding, unused vertices and ordering; no repair, weld, decimation, simplification, cap removal or overwrite.

exact_existing_export_blockers.finding: Unconditional vertices.cuda/faces.cuda, CuMesh construction and fill_holes. remesh=False still simplifies twice, removes duplicate faces/components, repairs nonmanifold edges, fills holes and unifies orientations; remesh=True rebuilds topology. No preserve-topology flag.

uv_unwrap unconditionally calls remove_degenerate_faces, accelerated compute_charts, then CPU _xatlas packing; vertex maps reindex/duplicate seam vertices. Raw nonmanifold full mesh UV success is unqualified; source provides no preservation guarantee.
Texture bake requires CuMesh/cubvh for closest-point mapping, _nvdiffrast_c RasterizeCudaContext/rasterize/interpolate, and FlexGEMM grid_sample_3d on cuda. Native GPU path, not a CPU serializer.
Trellis2OvoxelExportToGLB explicitly requests remesh=True and remesh_project=0; incompatible with unmodified original geometry.
Geometry helper remeshes/repairs/fills holes, fixes winding, strips ground-cap faces and constructs Trimesh(process=True). Not a preservation-safe shortcut.

existing_vertex_bake_branch.output: Trimesh(process=False) with per-vertex base RGB and alpha; placeholder textures. Learned metallic/roughness are not exported in this branch.
existing_vertex_bake_branch.alpha_caveat: OPAQUE forces alpha=255; other choices sample alpha values, but this ColorVisuals branch does not explicitly attach a PBR alphaMode.
existing_vertex_bake_branch.axes: Select reorient_vertices=None for raw XYZ; default rotates axes.

learned_material_contract.emissive: Not in active inference pbr_attr_layout or either exporter; dataset classes mentioning emissive do not establish trained/output/export support.
learned_material_contract.GLB_textures: Base-color PNG RGBA; metallicRoughness texture R=0,G=roughness,B=metallic; material factors 1.0. Stock alphaMode=OPAQUE; AMD UV node exposes MASK/BLEND.
learned_material_contract.existing_shape_features: Current seven geometry channels are dual-vertex logits, intersection logits and split weight, not learned PBR values. No texture attributes in the qualified shape artifact.

WSL_state_from_latest_complete_staging_r.ABI: Windows cp311/cp312 PE wheels cannot be used as WSL ELF libraries. Reference Linux Torch2.13/ROCm7.2.4 differs from current Torch2.9.1/ROCm7.2.1; no native ABI or full texture-bake qualification inferred.

existing_fixes_and_reference.finding: inpaint_channel restores singleton channel dimension for OpenCV output; reusable channel-shape fix, not a native/UV/topology solution.
Resets metallicFactor to zero based on a color-only assumption. Do not reuse for genuine learned metallic/roughness textures; it would suppress learned metallicity.
Excludes cumesh/remeshing.py from the incompatible generic remeshing patch; fixes a historical missing-hashmap failure, but still performs topology-changing remeshing.

Cached local assessment reports genuine 512 textured GLB, PyTorch vectorized rasterizer fallback, signature-aware export, CuMesh HIP memcpy fix and guarded hole fills. Author reports raw nonfinite geometry removed during export. This does not qualify untouched nonmanifold mesh UV/baking here; no source/binary fixes transplanted.

one_recommended_texture_plan: Keep the exact full PLY and arrays immutable. Reuse saved shape latent/conditioning/subdivision support for separately authorized texture flow/decoder work; do not rerun geometry or re-encode/repair this full mesh.

Persist the finite six-channel sparse PBR field and coordinates before any export. Then use a CPU sparse trilinear sampler at original vertex positions, preserving original order and all triangles; save RGBA and separate metallic/roughness/alpha arrays.

Cheapest initial material export: a CPU GLB writer from unchanged vertices/indices with vertex RGBA and explicitly documented constant rough/nonmetal material. This bypasses UV/CuMesh/nvdiffrast and works independently of manifoldness. It is a learned base-color preview, not full spatial metallic/roughness PBR.

Full standard learned-PBR GLB still needs UV textures. No existing drop-in preservation-safe path is qualified: isolate UV/baking on an export copy and validate identical triangle geometry while accounting for seam duplication; never invoke repairs or overwrite the original. Treat that as a later bounded export qualification.

CPU_export_availability.preserved_AI_envs: Both contain Trimesh5.1.1, NumPy, Pillow and OpenCV; availability from saved metadata, no import qualification performed.
CPU_export_availability.cheapest_no_install_choice: Existing contained CPU/NumPy helper plus a small GLB serializer, or existing Blender5.2 CPU exporter; neither executed in this audit.

limitations: Static local source and preserved manifests only. No claim that nonmanifold UV unwrapping, native rasterization or learned texture inference currently works. No model/checkpoint payloads inspected.
